rootCauseIEstablishedMyself.whatFix135Named: A null-coercion in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs: groupIntoLines emits run.x2 null for an unmeasurable run, and captureWidgetContext tests 'run.x2 > rect.x + 1' then coerces that null in 'rect.x - run.x2'.
rootCauseIEstablishedMyself.thatIsTheSymptom: It is real -- three sites coerce a null x2 (captureWidgetContext line 888, cellTextLeftOf line 777, pageRegions xRight line 846) -- but it is not why the widths are null.
rootCauseIEstablishedMyself.theCause: Every text font on DC 1:15 is a Type0 composite font that ships its own metrics. I read the source's font resources directly: pages 1 and 2 carry 21 /Type0 fonts (subsetted TimesNewRoman), every one with DescendantFonts, a /W array and /DW 1000. The module never reads them because rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs:260 is 'const twoByte = subtype === "Type0"' while subtype is a stringified PDFName and therefore reads '/Type0'. The comparison is permanently false, so cidWidths is never consulted and every glyph on the form measures null.
rootCauseIEstablishedMyself.measured: On the pinned DC 1:15 (sha256 43675986d4b740ebb26c0b6778655e25f5d1bd6145a439154b00350c6072cd5b): page 1, 113 of 130 runs carry x2 null; page 2, 101 of 119. Every run reports metricsExact false. All four named widgets return effectiveLabel null with labelBasis no_printed_caption_within_reach, while the line above Text44 plainly prints '__________________________, Judge of the ____________________Court of'.
rootCauseIEstablishedMyself.whyIDidNotFixIt: The module itself flags this trap and refuses it, for a reason I confirmed rather than inherited: twoByte also drives two-byte string walking, so repairing the comparison changes the decoded TEXT of every Type0 run, not only its width. The module says that lands on all 208 of its importers at once, including caption harvesting and field classification, and collapseUtf16BE exists downstream specifically to compensate for the present behaviour. The two concerns are not separable: CID widths are keyed by codes the walker is currently mis-splitting, so reading /W without fixing the decoding yields wrong widths. A lane holding four families does not get to decide what 208 importers produce on their next rebuild.
rootCauseIEstablishedMyself.whatARollbackWouldCost: FIX135 proved that reverting this one file to e258e47a0^ makes the unmodified builder reproduce the committed digests exactly. It would also restore the behaviour that commit removed: a uniform 500/1000 half-em fabricated for every glyph. The committed NE packet's DC 1:15 captions, and the court-owned vs participant-owned role classification derived from them, were harvested under that fabricated ruler. Restoring the packet by that route restores it on invented geometry.
